mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_knowledge_governance_projections (id, tenant_id, proposal_id, projection_type, status, details, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.proposalId}, #{row.projectionType}, #{row.status}, #{row.details,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, proposal_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, proposal_id, projection_type, status, details, error, created_at, updated_at FROM public.nw_knowledge_governance_projections WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND proposal_id = #{proposalId} FOR UPDATE
